text: カツだけ　やれば　いいじゃない！

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: A verb with ば plus いい means 'it's enough to do that', a way of saying what someone should do. やれば　いい = 'he should just do it'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃない
patterns.explanation: じゃない at the end here does not mean 'not'; it pushes the listener to agree. いいじゃない = 'that's fine, isn't it!'.

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ after a word means 'only'. カツだけ = 'only Katsu'.
